parameters.query:
SELECT mes, cobros, total
FROM (
    SELECT CONVERT(char(7), fecha_cobro, 126) AS mes, COUNT(*) AS cobros, SUM(importe) AS total, 0 AS orden
    FROM dbo.cobros
    GROUP BY CONVERT(char(7), fecha_cobro, 126)
    UNION ALL
    SELECT 'TOTAL', COUNT(*), SUM(importe), 1
    FROM dbo.cobros
) AS r
ORDER BY orden, mes;
